source_text.body:
Draft a legal notice to get a defective laptop refunded
Poster used Claude to write a legal notice and got a full refund for a defective refurbished MacBook within 48 hours.
·
May 1, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
The poster described the purchase, failure, warranty status, and the company’s 85% refund offer in a plain back-and-forth on claude.ai, then shared screenshots of the company’s replies so Claude could refine the wording. Claude surfaced Indian consumer-law citations, found the company’s grievance officer email, and drafted a pre-litigation notice; the poster critically reviewed and iterated instead of sending the first draft.
How it went
After the email, they got an acknowledgment in an hour, an escalation reply within 24 hours, and a full refund of Rs. 40,219 within 48 hours. In comments, the poster said this was for a simple consumer dispute and that they validated the output by reviewing it, not by trusting Claude blindly.
Worth knowing
They said this used the free tier with no Projects or PDF uploads; the main catch was to give detailed context and revise the draft carefully yourself.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Help me draft a formal legal notice to [seller name] about a defective [product] I bought on [date] for [price]. The problem is [describe defect and what the seller said], and I want [refund or replacement] within [number] days. Cite the consumer protection rules for [my country or state], keep the tone firm and polite, and give me the finished notice plus a short checklist of evidence to attach. I will send it myself.
